messages.subject: Embedding HTML in multiple choice questions
parts:
For our project, some questions are required to have images in them and the way we are solving this is by embedding the HTML directly in the question text. This has worked for us, but whenever we want to have options that are images, the HTML embedding does not work.

Is there a way to "force" this to work or a better way to do what we are trying to accomplish?

Best,
Ryan Kelley

Embedding images should be possible, though I'm not certain it has ever been tested (symbols and such, yes, but external images I don't believe so). Could you provide your current code as an example of one such item so that I have something to replicate the issue? Thanks. 

Phil
